items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I got Chubby Jackson his job in Barnet's band recently -- I always needed a bass player.

ctx.x: Most of the jazz magazines, and most of the histories of you says '47 with Glen Gray. Now when were you with -- and you say I'm going back, I would like to keep this in perspective, if I possibly can, according to what you want -- it's your story. But when were you with Woodie and when did you recommend Ralph Burns.
Well, I got Chubby Jackson his job in Barnet's band recently -- I always needed a bass player.
